messages:
alex (DevEx): Quick sync — SampleKit launch gate. Target ship window Tue 2024-06-25 18:00 PT. Calling out owners: SDK, Docs, Sample Apps. One-line status + any blockers please. @maria @sachin @jen @taylor

maria (Docs): Ack. Changelog cutoff: Fri 2024-06-21 23:59 UTC. Anything merged after that goes to next patch. I can cherry-pick critical doc fixes if you flag them.

sachin (SDK): On it. SDK API freeze is set. Two open PRs that we need reviewed: #432 (streaming edge-case) and #451 (breaking typing change). Need one more reviewer for #451 — tagging @jen for a quick look. If #451 blocks, we can ship without the type refinements and patch later.

jen (Eng): I can review #451 in ~2h. Found one sample app runtime flake yesterday when running long prompt tests — intermittent KV-cache OOM on smaller GPU profiles. Repro steps below:

jen (Eng): ```bash
# repro (local)
python samples/run_sample.py --model redwood/llama-7b --profile small --length 4096
```

jen (Eng): error snippet: ```json
{"level":"error","msg":"KV cache overflow at step 128","service":"samplekit-runner"}
```

jen (Eng): I opened a hotfix PR: #471 — small change to cap sequence-length before batch concat. It passes local smoke. If ops agrees, we should include in release.

taylor (PM): Thanks. Ownership: Alex you own release cut; Maria docs cutoff; Sachin SDK decisions; Jen sample apps + runtime fixes. Rollback policy: if any regression >1% perf or obvious correctness, we halt and roll back to previous tag. Decision lead: Taylor.

alex (DevEx): Plan: freeze branch Mon 2024-06-24 12:00 PT; release candidate build after freeze. Please confirm by EOD Mon. For sample apps we need final quickstarts updated and a smoke matrix (node/python, small/medium profile). Can each owner post a single-line "ready" when done?

maria (Docs): Ready to produce changelog and quickstart diff. Will push doc PRs by Mon 09:00 PT.

sachin (SDK): Running tests now. If #451 passes CI and jen gives LGTM on behavior, I will cut the SDK tag. ETA Mon 10:30 PT.

jen (Eng): LGTM on #451 after small tweak. #471 hotfix needs runtime approval from eng-infra but should be safe. I can shepherd infra review — pinging @eng-infra in separate thread. For smoke: I ran the matrix and added results to the release checklist doc (link: https://redwood.internal/release/samplekit-checklist). All green except small-profile long prompts.

alex (DevEx): For sample app smoke please run: ```bash
./scripts/smoke.sh --matrix node,python --profiles small,medium --report artifacts/smoke-$(date +%s).json
```

shipbot: [automated] rc build queued: samplekit-rc-20240624-789. Status: queued -> running.

shipbot: [automated] rc build complete: samplekit-rc-20240624-789 (artifacts available). CI: 312 tests passed, 2 flaky skipped.

taylor (PM): Good. If RC build is clean, proceed with canary rollout to 10% dedicated pools, monitor token-rate and error-rate for 30m. Ops will run autoscale smoke.

sachin (SDK): Canary SDK tag published: v0.9.0-rc. Included #432 fix. Waiting for jen's hotfix merge to include #471.

jen (Eng): Hotfix #471 merged into rc, infra gave thumbs up. Re-ran smoke, small-profile long prompt now stable in my local runs.

alex (DevEx): Status update summary for release doc: 
- Docs: on schedule (maria)
- SDK: rc tag published, waiting final CI pass (sachin)
- Sample apps/runtime: hotfix merged (jen), smoke mostly green
- Build: rc artifacts ready (shipbot)
- Cut: scheduled Mon 12:00 PT (alex)

alex (DevEx): If no objections, I'll cut the branch at freeze and tag in the morning. Please leave any late blockers here. :thumbsup:

maria (Docs): +1 :thumbsup:

sachin (SDK): +1 :shipit:

jen (Eng): +1, will monitor post-cut canary.

taylor (PM): +1 — I'll start canary monitor playbook at rollout.

alex (DevEx): Thanks all. Closing thread for async updates — will post a short post-cut checklist after branch cut.
